segmentation.text: must be driven only upon the right-hand roadway
and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section
or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn,
except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space
or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

elements.justification: 'Vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; ru.aggregate: 'membership of a legal aggregate: the atom's literal argument is an aggregate id'. No named class stands in for it.

DEF-NRS-484A-070: 'a highway divided into two or more roadways by means of a physical barrier or dividing section'. st.highway: 'the entire public way between its boundary lines'; st.median_or_divider: 'physical barrier or dividing section between roadways'; st.on_way: 'the public way (a highway region) a structure region lies on — a lane, roadway, shoulder, crosswalk, stop line, median or any other part of it' ties the divider to the highway h; rel.occupies anchors the subject on h ('on a highway' maps the same way in the index). The definition's 'constructed so as to impede the conflict' states the divider's purpose and is read through its presence. 'Driven' is read through the vehicle's motion.

Each roadway of a divided highway carries one direction of travel (st.roadway: 'separate roadways of a divided highway are separate'); the right-hand roadway is the one whose designated direction the vehicle travels with. Being driven on a roadway of h (rel.occupies, st.on_way) other than the right-hand one is moving against that roadway's designated direction: drv.motion.moving_against_carrier 'Road user a moves against the designated direction of travel of carrier region r' (proposed this iteration), with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance. The concept reads st.lane_direction and kin.velocity; it is not a stand-in for heading, so a vehicle pointing either way is judged by its motion.

st.median_or_divider carries an 'opening attribute where a crossover exists': 'through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space' is the subject's footprint overlapping (rel.occupies) a divider region of h that carries the opening attribute.

A crossover is a divider region with the opening attribute ('opening attribute where a crossover exists'); an intersection is st.intersection, 'the region where two roadways meet'; rel.occupies places the subject at it. 'Established by a public authority' (DEF-NRS-484A-195) is a legal status read through the feature's presence.

applicability: At every observation at which the subject occupies a highway h (st.highway) on which a median_or_divider region lies (st.on_way), except where the subject's footprint overlaps a divider region lying on h that carries the opening attribute (an opening or a crossover), or an intersection lying on h.
obligation: Re-binding h as in the applicability: for every roadway r lying on h (st.on_way) that the subject's footprint overlaps, drv.motion.moving_against_carrier(subject, r) with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance does not hold: the subject is not driven on a roadway of the divided highway against its designated direction. Unknown where r carries no designated direction or the subject's velocity is unobserved.

narrowings.why: 'the right-hand roadway' is read through the designated direction of the roadway the vehicle is on: it is driven on the right-hand roadway where it does not move against that roadway's direction. A source that records no direction on a divider's roadways leaves the duty unknown.
'driven' is read through the vehicle's motion on the highway, whoever or whatever controls it.
'established by a public authority' is a legal status; the crossover or intersection present on the road is its evidence.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A st.median_or_divider lies on highway h; the subject occupies the roadway r of h on the far side of the divider and its kin.velocity runs against r's st.lane_direction: moving_against_carrier holds.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The subject occupies the roadway of h whose st.lane_direction its velocity follows; moving_against_carrier does not hold for any roadway it overlaps.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject drives against a roadway's direction on a highway on which no st.median_or_divider lies: no divided highway.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The subject occupies a roadway of the divided highway h; st.lane_direction is absent on the source, so moving_against_carrier is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject crosses the opposing roadway's edge while its footprint overlaps an intersection lying on h: the exception for an intersection holds.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's kinematic channels
